_comment: Neutral values for new files of a model that has no factory state in templates/factory (button 'New'; the FS7M2 starts from its factory files): only items for which the manual gives a default of +-0, set on top of the model's template (a real camera file). This is NOT a factory dump: the manual and the web publish no complete default scene file. Keys are SCENE IDs; zeros = all fields 0, zeros_keep_first = first field kept.
